verdict.rationale: Better Stack has escalation policies, monitors and incident workflows, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack shows no native version history, change review, or rollback for these configurations. The Terraform and API mentions only offer config-as-code building blocks; a user could version those externally in their own tooling, which is a workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Automate your workflows and integrate Better Stack with your existing tools using our APIs and protocols. ... Terraform
